summary: Israel Acquisitions Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K regarding a fifth amendment to its business combination agreement with Gadfin Ltd., an Israeli drone logistics company. The amendment extends the termination date to May 31, 2026, while all other termination rights remain unchanged. The BCA was originally entered on January 26, 2025, and previously amended multiple times. No financial terms were disclosed. The filing reflects ongoing efforts to close the de-SPAC transaction. Watch for the May 31 deadline — if not consummated, the SPAC may liquidate, and risk-arb spreads will reflect the time pressure and deal certainty.
